summary: Full documentation of every vidIQ feature available through both the web app (from screenshots) and the MCP server (from schema research). Covers 28 tools organized into categories: Free/Zero-Cost tools (balance check, voice listing), Research tools (keyword research, outliers, trending, similar channels/videos, channel stats, video stats, earnings estimates — all 5 credits each), Content Creation tools (script writer at 1 credit/min, title generator at 5 credits, thumbnail generator at 22 credits, motion graphics, video generation, voiceover, B-roll), and Analysis tools (channel analytics, video comments, transcripts, score title/thumbnail). Includes a complete credit cost table, the user's current balance (250 credits: 130 renewable resetting Aug 20 + 120 add-on), and a recommended spending strategy prioritizing keyword research and title scoring over expensive thumbnail/video generation.
